name: databasify
desc: An open-source, self-hostable DBaaS alternative to DigitalOcean Managed Databases, Amazon RDS & Aiven that lets you run PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Va…
descFull: An open-source, self-hostable DBaaS alternative to DigitalOcean Managed Databases, Amazon RDS & Aiven that lets you run PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Valkey and Redis, from a single node to a highly available cluster with automatic failover, point-in-time backups and TLS, on your own servers.
